notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0006 (mass nouns take a plural verb; relation takes_verb_form and the new value, a plural verb, are kept). Fictional subject: a made-up class, yarnwick nouns, newly coined nouns in -ics naming a field of work, under the real class of -ics nouns, which leaves the verb number open (mathematics is, statistics are, politics either), so the rule fills an empty slot; the first version put the class under 'mass noun', whose singular verb is fixed, which overwrote inherited knowledge. Derived queries name made-up members (plimmetics, zimbrelics, wrenthalics) with the membership in the prompt, so the rule is the only route. Near unrelated: the real -ics noun 'mathematics', outside the made-up class; a rule that leaks to every -ics noun answers 'are'.
